title: Luke Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Luke 9: the twelve sent out, the five loaves and two fish, Peter's answer and the voice from the cloud.

questions.text: What did he send the twelve out to do?
questions.explanation: He sent them out to preach God's Kingdom and to heal the sick.

answers.text: Preach God's Kingdom and heal the sick
Build a synagogue in every village
Teach only the children of Israel to read the law

questions.text: What did he tell the twelve to take along for their journey?
questions.explanation: He told them to take nothing for their journey - no staffs, no wallet, no bread and no money - and not to have two coats each.

questions.text: What did Herod say he had done to John?
questions.explanation: Herod said, "I beheaded John," and wondered who this was about whom he heard such things.

answers.text: He had sent him to Jerusalem
He had made him a steward

questions.text: What food did the disciples say they had for the crowd?
questions.explanation: The disciples said they had no more than five loaves and two fish.

answers.text: Seven loaves and a few small fish

questions.text: How much was left over after the crowd had eaten?
questions.explanation: They ate and were all filled, and they gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

answers.text: Two baskets of bread and fish
Nothing at all was left over

questions.text: What did Peter answer when he was asked, "But who do you say that I am?"
Who were the two men talking with him on the mountain?
questions.explanation: The text says the two men who were talking with him were Moses and Elijah.

questions.text: What did the voice out of the cloud say?
questions.explanation: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, "This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!"

answers.text: "This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!"
"Fear not, for I am with you."
"Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!"

questions.text: What did Jesus do when the disciples argued about which of them was the greatest?
questions.explanation: Jesus took a little child and set him by his side, and said that whoever is least among them all will be great.

answers.text: He sent them to another village
He set a little child by his side

questions.text: What did he say about the person who puts his hand to the plow and looks back?
questions.explanation: He said that no one who puts his hand to the plow and looks back is fit for God's Kingdom.

answers.text: He will plow a crooked furrow
He is not fit for God's Kingdom
He will be forgiven seven times
He must first say good-bye at home
